attire.label: What to Wear
attire.title: Guest Attire
attire.description: We kindly request that our guests dress in semi-formal attire for our celebration.

men.title: For Him
men.description: A suit or blazer with dress pants and a tie or pocket square. Dress shoes are recommended.

women.title: For Her
women.description: A cocktail dress, elegant jumpsuit, or a dressy skirt and blouse combination. Heels or dressy flats are recommended. For comfort on the garden grounds, we suggest block heels.

attire.note: Please avoid jeans, sneakers, and overly casual attire. When in doubt, lean towards more formal.
